{{Quote|Commander Akobi, you'll be stationed in one of Section N-Twelve's command sprawls, along the northern polar trench.|An [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]], to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Akobi]]|<ref name="Empire 13" />}}
'''Section N-Twelve''',<ref name="Empire 13" /> also referred to as '''N12''', was one of twelve equally-sized zones on the northern hemisphere of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], a massive [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] built by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Like the other twenty-three sections on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], the zone covered 31.4 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] of the Death Star's circumference, was commanded from a [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], and contained a number of sectors with designated purposes.<ref name="DSTC" /> The Death Star, including zone N12, was destroyed in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Destruction date" /> Zone N12 bordered zones [[N11]] and [[Sector N-One/Legends|N1]].<ref name="DSTC" />

Zone N12 contained [[Sector A79]].<ref name="Empire 13" />
